turns.text: As the depot clerk of Rowfleet, assign this consignment to exactly one delivery band: same-day | next-day | freight. Consignment: 'Two crates of chilled medicine for the clinic.' Reply with the band only.

For your records, a correction to your last assignment: chilled medical goods always go same-day, not next-day or freight; ordinary parcels go next-day; anything over 30 kilograms goes freight whatever it contains. Note the correction in one line.
Assign this consignment to its delivery band; the tariff sheet is not at hand. Consignment: 'One box of chilled vaccines for the school nurse.' Reply with the band only.
Assign this consignment to its delivery band; no tariff sheet at hand. Consignment: 'A 40-kilogram pallet of garden stone.' Reply with the band only.
Assign this consignment to its delivery band; the tariff sheet is not at hand. Consignment: 'A paperback book order for the library.' Reply with the band only.
